verdict.rationale: Vestd documents granting option schemes (EMI, CSOP, unapproved) on its platform, offers 409A valuations for a small fee for UK companies issuing options to US taxpayers, and claims board-ready equity governance with deed and witness signatures. However, nothing shows these joined into one end-to-end grant workflow, and no board-approval step is explicitly tied to option issuance. The 409A valuation reads as a separate paid add-on, not something that automatically sets the strike price within the grant flow. missing for 10: an explicit board-approval step in the option grant flow, 409A valuation feeding the strike price inside the grant workflow, evidence of a single end-to-end process, independent or hands-on corroboration.
